name: Old Snag
what: Act One, Relic-Bearer of the Verdant Wilds, the Thornsplitter Hatchet still in his shoulder. Tusk, Trample, Bristle, Wallow, Splitting Charge.
about: A boar the size of a cart with a ranger's hatchet buried in his shoulder. Shaggy brown, pale stripes down his flanks, a crest of black bristles over his shoulders, yellowed tusks. He has not forgotten the ranger. 1.3 m to the top of his bristles.
